# TagHost Plugin for Google Antigravity

Connect Google Antigravity directly to [TagHost](https://taghost.io) — autonomous edge hosting, deployments, headless CMS collections, in-context edge content editing, TagMail, custom domains, serverless D1 SQL, and edge commerce on Cloudflare.

## Install

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/georgennad/taghost-antigravity-plugin
```

## Authentication & Permissions (OAuth 2.1)

This plugin connects to the hosted TagHost Remote MCP server at `https://mcp.taghost.io/mcp` using **OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration)**.

When you first invoke a TagHost tool, Antigravity automatically opens `https://console.taghost.io/oauth/authorize` in your browser so you can:

1. Choose which **workspace** to connect.
2. Select **granular least-privilege permissions** (`projects:read`, `deployments:write`, `content:write`, `domains:write`, `mail:read`, `mail:send`, `commerce:write`, `forms:read`, `sql:read`, `workspace:collaborate`) or pick a preset (`Read-only`, `Developer`, `Select all`).
3. Revoke access anytime from **Console → Settings → API Keys**.

## Included Customizations

- **MCP Server:** `https://mcp.taghost.io/mcp` (Streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1)
- **Skill:** `skills/taghost-edge-cloud/SKILL.md`
- **Rules:** `rules/AGENTS.md`

## Links

- Homepage: https://taghost.io
- Documentation: https://docs.taghost.io/developers/mcp
- Official MCP Registry: `io.taghost/mcp` (`https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=io.taghost/mcp`)
- Privacy Policy: https://taghost.io/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://taghost.io/terms
- Support: georgennad@gmail.com
